cases.sentence: Один из семи ___, у которых было семь чаш, подошел ко мне и сказал.
cases.translation: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came to me and spoke.
cases.explain: The noun ангел is the subject of the verb подошел (came), so it stands in nominative case.

cases.sentence: Я покажу тебе, как будет наказана великая блудница, сидящая на многих ___.
cases.translation: I will show you how the great prostitute sitting on many waters will be judged.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) with location meaning uses the prepositional case.

cases.translation: The kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her.
cases.explain: The preposition of possession 'of' is expressed in Russian by the genitive case: царей земли.

cases.sentence: И я увидел женщину, сидящую на алом ___.
cases.translation: I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet-colored beast.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) governing location uses the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Семь голов — это семь ___, на которых сидит женщина.
cases.translation: The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.
cases.explain: The numeral семь (seven) with plural genitive denotes a quantity: семь гор.

cases.sentence: В руке у нее была золотая ___, наполненная мерзостью.
cases.translation: In her hand was a golden bowl full of abominations.
cases.explain: The noun чаша is the predicate nominative with the verb была (was), so it stands in nominative case.

cases.sentence: На лбу у нее написано ___, имеющее тайное значение.
cases.translation: On her forehead was written a name having a secret meaning.
cases.explain: The noun имя is the subject of the passive construction написано, so it stands in nominative case.

cases.sentence: Женщина, которую ты видел, — это великий ___, царствующий над всеми царями земли.
cases.translation: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over all the kings of the earth.
cases.explain: The noun город is the predicate nominative after the verb быть (to be), so it stands in nominative case.

reading.ru: Один из семи ангелов, у которых было семь чаш, подошел ко мне и сказал.
reading.question: What did one of the seven angels do?
options: Came to the speaker and spoke
reading.correct: Came to the speaker and spoke
reading.explain: The text says один из семи ангелов подошел ко мне и сказал (one of the seven angels came to me and spoke).

reading.ru: Подойди, я покажу тебе, как будет наказана великая блудница, сидящая на многих водах.
reading.question: What did the angel offer to show?
options: The judgment of the great prostitute sitting on many waters
reading.correct: The judgment of the great prostitute sitting on many waters
reading.explain: The angel said я покажу тебе, как будет наказана великая блудница (I will show you how the great prostitute will be judged).

reading.ru: С ней развратничали цари земли, и жители земли упивались вином ее разврата.
reading.question: What did the kings of the earth and the people do with the prostitute?
options: Committed sexual immorality with her and became drunk with her wine
reading.correct: Committed sexual immorality with her and became drunk with her wine
reading.explain: The text states цари земли развратничали с ней и жители земли упивались вином ее разврата (the kings committed sin with her and the people became drunk with her wine).

reading.ru: И я увидел женщину, сидящую на алом звере, который был исписан кощунственными именами.
reading.question: What was the beast covered with?
reading.explain: The text describes the beast as исписан кощунственными именами (covered with blasphemous names).

reading.ru: Женщина была одета во все пурпурное и алое, была украшена золотом, драгоценными камнями и жемчугом.
reading.question: How was the woman dressed and adorned?
options: In purple and scarlet, decorated with gold, precious stones, and pearls
In white linen with a golden crown
reading.correct: In purple and scarlet, decorated with gold, precious stones, and pearls
reading.explain: The text says она была одета во все пурпурное и алое и украшена золотом, драгоценными камнями и жемчугом (she was dressed in purple and scarlet and decorated with gold, precious stones, and pearls).

reading.ru: На лбу у нее написано имя, имеющее тайное значение: великий Вавилон, мать блудниц и мерзостей земли.
reading.question: What name was written on her forehead?
options: Great Babylon, mother of prostitutes and of the abominations of the earth
reading.correct: Great Babylon, mother of prostitutes and of the abominations of the earth
reading.explain: The text explicitly states На лбу у нее написано имя: великий Вавилон, мать блудниц и мерзостей земли.
